slides.texte_overlay:
Social skills that make
people remember you
Introducing people warmly. "This is Sam, he just ran his first marathon." A great introduction makes both people feel good.
Asking the second question. Most people stop after one. "And how did that feel?" is where real conversations begin.
Remembering birthdays and big days. A message on the right day shows people they matter to you. Set reminders and write a short, personal message.
Making people laugh without putting anyone down. Warm humour brings people together and makes you good company.
Before: I was forgettable in groups. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and people now remember the stories I tell.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: I was forgettable in groups. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. People now remember the stories I tell.

slides.texte_overlay: Being fully present. Phone away, eyes up, real attention. It's rare, and people notice it immediately. Be there.
Following up after meeting someone. "Great to meet you yesterday." Few people do it, so it stands out. Send the message.
